name: Critters in the wild
summary:
Welcome to.. the wild

Critters in the wild is a enjoyable game that you can play alone or with friends, its movement is based of the highly famous game gorilla tag and has many things to offer, 

you can
- Play tag with friends
- Play with some of the toys
- Explore the map
- and just chill!

theres alot planned to be added to this game so your download always helps out!
